items.title: Lead Data Engineer
description: Lead the structuring and industrialization of the cloud data platform around Databricks, Azure, and Azure Data Factory.
Contribute to the validation of a Databricks-on-AWS proof of concept and to the build of the official target platform on Azure.
Design robust, idempotent, and reliability-oriented ingestion and transformation pipelines for data and BI use cases.
Optimize ingestion patterns with Azure Data Factory and support on-premise to cloud migrations.
Drive architecture, governance, and Databricks cost optimization best practices to support Power BI and analytics workloads.

items.title: Data Engineer
description: Design and optimize data models and databases to make operational data accessible across teams.
Build data and BI tools that transform fragmented information into reliable KPIs and actionable insights.
Help establish a stronger data culture in an industrial environment of 200+ employees.
Translate business needs into maintainable analytics solutions with cross-functional stakeholders.

items.title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Analyze large data sets to define and monitor sales and operations KPIs.
Develop and maintain dashboards used to track business performance.
Apply machine learning models to forecast sales seasonality and improve planning accuracy.
Transform exploratory analysis into reporting outputs that business teams can use in practice.

about.title: How I work
about.intro: I work at the intersection of engineering depth and business usefulness.
about.paragraph_1: My focus is to design data platforms that teams can trust: reliable ingestion, maintainable transformations, scalable compute, and clear ownership.
about.paragraph_2: I am most effective when a company needs both technical rigor and product thinking, especially when BI, operations, and engineering have to align around the same platform decisions.
about.paragraph_3: Outside work, I care about sustainability and reading, and I am especially passionate about climbing and running.
